title: Everyday Food and Drinks
introduction: Recognise foods and drinks in everyday life.
definition: Recognise foods and drinks in everyday life.
rules: Say each word aloud. Look for examples in everyday life.
Practise the sentences with a partner.

vocabulary.description: Food often laid by a hen.

exercises.question: Which is a drink? (water or bread)
exercises.solution: Water is a liquid we drink; bread is food we eat.

exercises.question: Which fruit is long and often yellow?
exercises.solution: A banana is a curved fruit that is often yellow when ripe.

exercises.question: Which food is a grain? (rice or egg)
exercises.solution: Rice is a grain; an egg is not.

exercises.question: Which vegetable is often orange?
exercises.solution: A carrot is a root vegetable, often orange.

exercises.question: Which food is liquid and eaten with a spoon?
exercises.solution: Soup is a liquid food often eaten with a spoon.

exercises.question: Which drink is made from fruit?
exercises.solution: Juice is a drink made from the liquid of fruit.

summary: Recognise foods and drinks in everyday life.
